levels.surface: محمّد بن عيسى بن عبيد اليقطينيّ
محمّد بن عيسى بن عبيد اليقطينيّ

notes: This is al-Faqih's own statement of his routes («طرق») to Muhammad b. Isa, with no saying (rule 11): both routes are read as written, but a ruling is needed on how the statement is to be stored
«رضي اللّه عنه» blessings are left out
«أبي» is the compiler's own shaykh written as a bare relation (rule 7)
